hypotheses.claim: Archive reuse beats fresh random sampling on diversity and quality.
hypotheses.test_plan: Paired seeds 7,11,23; same initial genomes and evaluation budget.
hypotheses.kill_condition: Reject if mean coverage gain <0.10 or relative QD gain <0.10; missing pairs => UNKNOWN.

hypotheses.claim: The fixed mixed operator policy adds value over mutation-only.
hypotheses.test_plan: Paired seeds 7,11,23 under identical environment and budgets.
hypotheses.kill_condition: Reject if mixed policy improves QD by <2% or loses >1 percentage point coverage.

hypotheses.claim: The local evidence gate fails closed under the covered fault cases.
hypotheses.test_plan: Run test_bridge and anchor every run's ledger head and length.
hypotheses.kill_condition: Any covered corrupt/missing evidence is accepted, any chain fails, or any production authorization appears.
